# ReShade FX

The standalone ReShade FX parser, preprocessor and SPIR-V generator from
<https://github.com/crosire/reshade/tree/7bf9de8b33bcc76c3177007e65d73c72dd0f34c0/source>.
The selected files are unmodified upstream copies under BSD-3-Clause. See `LICENSE.md`.

Longshot supplies its restricted include resolver outside this directory. The ReShade runtime,
injector, overlay and other shader backends are outside this source subset.
